# secure-kb

> Merged, AI-agent-searchable security verification knowledge base: 2,032 atomic check cards distilled
> from 67 tracked sources (cards drawn from 15 repositories + 5 official-doc sources), covering web, API, mobile, Telegram bots, cloud, IoT, smart
> contracts, LLM apps, vibe-coded apps, browser extensions and desktop.

Start here: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — the only file an agent needs to read first.

## Key files
- [index/checks.jsonl](index/checks.jsonl) — all cards, one JSON per line (grep/jq friendly)
- [index/kb.sqlite](index/kb.sqlite) — SQLite FTS5 search index
- [manifest.json](manifest.json) — version, counts, content hash
- [sources.yaml](sources.yaml) — all 67 sources with commit SHA + license
- [schema/check.schema.json](schema/check.schema.json) — card schema

## Interfaces
- CLI: `cli/secure_kb.py` (detect | profile | search | get | cwe | ref | tools | report)
- MCP: `mcp/server.py` (detect_stack, get_profile, search_checks, get_check, list_tools, start_report, submit_result)

## Layout
- `checks/<platform>/<domain>/*.yaml` — source-of-truth cards
- `profiles/<platform>.yaml` — ordered launch gates
- `playbooks/` — quick-15, pr-review, pre-launch, full-audit
- `tools/` — scanner adapters (no vendored code)
- `fixtures/` — lab -> check mappings for benchmarking
- `references/` — Tier-3 link index + known gaps
